title: One payment, stamped
label: One large payment document sits on a short pile beside the heading, its amount at display size. Its three policy checks tick one by one, a stamp press slams down and leaves APPROVED inked onto it at a slight angle, the approver's signature writes itself and a seal is pressed beside it. The finished payment slides off and the next one rises from the pile: a payout, an invoice and a payroll run in turn.
heading:
Nothing pays
until it's
approved.
sub: Each payment is checked against policy, stamped, signed and sealed before any money moves.
